detail.title: CP-UNR-408T2-AI
detail.overview: 8 Ch. PoE H.265 AI Mobile Network Video Recorder
features: Supports 8 Ch. 2MP PoE IP cameras input
Support 2 HDD and 1 SD card, 3 USB Ports (2.0)
Mobile Software: EMSS Pro, iCMOB/gCMOB (Live  view and Playback)
CMS Software: EMSS Pro, KVMS Pro (Live view and  Playback)

General.IP Camera Input: 8 PoE Ethernet Ports, all channels 1080P  Total output power of one group: 36 W (ch1-ch4 as one group, ch5-ch8 as one group)  Max. output power of a single port: 25.4 W
General.Video Output: AV OUT x 1, VGA x 1 , HDMI x 1
General.Alarm Input: 8 channels for alarm input, 1 channel for pulse speed measuring
General.Alarm Output: 1 channel of controllable 12V alarm output, digital quantity
General.Image Quality Adjustment: Image quality adjustable across six levels
General.Dual-Stream: Supported (up to D1 encoding for sub stream)
General.Recording Mode: Auto, Manual, motion detection, schedule, alarm Record alarm > alarm > motion detection >  schedule
General.OSD: Channel, time, GPS position, license plate
General.Backup Mode: HDD, USB flash drive and network backup
General.Interface Ports: Front panel: 2 × USB 2.0 Rear panel: 1 × USB 2.0 from EXTEND port, 3 Port RS232,  2 Port RS485, 1 TV Output, 1 Pulse Count, 1 CAN Port
General.Alarm Linkage: Record, snapshot, local external alarm output, buzzer, log, screen prompt, tour
General.General Alarm: Motion detection, video tampering and loss, local alarm, camera offline, manual alarm control, face blacklist and restricted number plate list alarm
General.Gyroscope: Supports event detection and alarm such as rollover, collision, rapid speedup/slowdown/turn
General.Abnormal Alarm: No HDD, HDD error, insufficient capacity, illegal login, ACC off, high temperature, rollover,  battery low voltage, over speed, low speed, collision, tapid turn, rapid speedup, hard braking,  low battery safety exception, network security exception
General.Power Supply: DC 6-36V with the built-in UPS (Enables system protection in normal power cut-off and in  under voltage of vehicle battery.)
General.Dimension: 1 DIN Front panel: 190 mm × 60 mm (7.5’×2.4’) Rear panel: 180 mm × 50 mm (7.1’×2.0’)  Depth:190 mm (7.5’)
